sql:
-- D0 through 19:00 Beijing: TC all users vs SG Singapore Android.
WITH
tc_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_android AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
sg_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
raw AS (
  SELECT 'TC 全量（仅安卓）' AS cohort,v."#account_id" AS account_id,v."#event_name" AS event_name,v."#event_time" AS event_time
  FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN tc_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND b.user_id IS NULL AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 19:00:00'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'SG Android',v."#account_id",v."#event_name",v."#event_time"
  FROM ta.v_event_13 v LEFT JOIN sg_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN sg_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id INNER JOIN sg_country c ON v."#user_id"=c.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND b.user_id IS NULL AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 19:00:00'
),
cohort_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT cohort,account_id FROM raw WHERE event_name='new_role' AND account_id IS NOT NULL),
events AS (SELECT r.* FROM raw r JOIN cohort_users c ON r.cohort=c.cohort AND r.account_id=c.account_id),
gaps AS (
  SELECT cohort,account_id,event_time,
    date_diff('second',CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP),LEAD(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER(PARTITION BY cohort,account_id ORDER BY event_time)) AS gap_seconds
  FROM events WHERE event_name NOT LIKE '%app%'
),
profile AS (
  SELECT c.cohort,c.account_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gap_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN g.gap_seconds ELSE 0 END)/60.0,0) AS active_minutes,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name='login' THEN e.event_time END) AS last_login_time
  FROM cohort_users c LEFT JOIN gaps g ON c.cohort=g.cohort AND c.account_id=g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN events e ON c.cohort=e.cohort AND c.account_id=e.account_id
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN last_login_time IS NULL OR date_diff('minute',CAST(last_login_time AS TIMESTAMP),CASE WHEN cohort='TC 全量（仅安卓）' THEN TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 19:00:00' ELSE TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 19:00:00' END)>=60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS idle_60m
  FROM profile
)
SELECT cohort,'overview' AS section,'all' AS segment,COUNT(*) AS users,
  ROUND(AVG(active_minutes),2) AS avg_active_minutes,APPROX_PERCENTILE(active_minutes,0.5) AS p50_active_minutes,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(idle_60m)/COUNT(*),1) AS idle_60m_rate_pct
FROM scored GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort,'duration_band',CASE WHEN active_minutes<5 THEN '<5m' WHEN active_minutes<15 THEN '5-15m' WHEN active_minutes<30 THEN '15-30m' WHEN active_minutes<60 THEN '30-60m' ELSE '60m+' END,
  COUNT(*),ROUND(AVG(active_minutes),2),APPROX_PERCENTILE(active_minutes,0.5),ROUND(100.0*SUM(idle_60m)/COUNT(*),1)
FROM scored GROUP BY 1,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3;
